privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how iToPhone handles information when you use our service.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide when creating an account (such as your name and email address), as well as usage data needed to operate the service, including search queries, device comparisons, and saved preferences.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to provide and improve the service, personalise content and recommendations, respond to your requests, and ensure the security and integrity of the platform.

sections.heading: AI and data processing
sections.body: iToPhone uses AI models to structure device specifications, discover product catalogs, and assist with editorial content. Automated processing is used to enhance accuracy and coverage of our catalog.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your preferences, such as language and theme. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We retain your data only as long as necessary to provide the service and comply with legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. Contact us to exercise these rights.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us via the channels listed on the site.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of the iToPhone service.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By accessing or using iToPhone, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, you may not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
sections.body: iToPhone provides phone specifications, comparison tools, price tracking, and carrier compatibility information. The catalog is assembled from public sources and may contain inaccuracies.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: The service is provided on an 'as is' basis. While we strive for accuracy, we make no guarantees regarding the completeness or correctness of any information, including specifications, prices, and network compatibility.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the service, attempt to disrupt it, scrape it at scale without permission, or use it for any unlawful purpose.

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity under your account. Admin and editor roles grant access to editorial tools and are subject to our internal policies.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: The iToPhone interface and editorial content are our property. Brand names, logos, and product names belong to their respective owners and are used for identification purposes only.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, iToPhone shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about these Terms, please contact us via the channels listed on the site.
